from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        shared_memory = operator.SharedMemory(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=4,
            num_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SHARED_ROW,
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SHARED_COL,
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SHARED_BOX,
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SHARED_CHECK,
            ],
            aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SHARED_AGGREGATOR_CANDIDATE_ONLY,
        )
        draft = await shared_memory(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=2,
            prompts=[
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SEQ_AUDIT_FROM_DRAFT,
                prompt_custom.SUDOKU_SEQ_FINAL_FORMAT,
            ],
        )
        solution = await seq(f"Puzzle:\n{problem}\n\nDraft candidate/result:\n{draft.get('response') or ''}")
        return solution["response"] or "```\n1 2 3 4\n3 4 1 2\n2 1 4 3\n4 3 2 1\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
